guestEvidence.displayDecision: Keep exact attributed excerpt and source link. Do not download new guest portraits or relabel property photos as guest-contributed photographs.

supported: Breakfast available; inclusion varies by room plan
servicePages.decision: Improve existing standalone dining page with a specific enquiry form and one-page planning guide. Do not create event or wedding landing pages from weak affiliate amenities.
servicePages.restaurantNaming: Booking's index says AUGUSTO KITCHEN; one guest says Aroma of Kashi. No owner-confirmed restaurant brand, so retain Hotel Augusto restaurant.

conflictingEstimates: Google prose labels temple 8 minutes walk, while nearby sights labels 11 mins without a reliable mode in the extracted text.
Google nearby sights labels Dashashwamedh Ghat 8 mins; no new rendered route was inspected.
Airport taxi estimate in Google reader is 1 hr 6 mins; this is dynamic, not a guarantee.
proximity.decision: Use qualitative walking proximity plus Google walking-direction links. Publish no measured distances or fixed travel times.

implementation.diningForm: Name optional, desired date, meal interest, party size and optional notes; validate locally and prepare an explicit WhatsApp draft. No enquiry storage or automatic message.
implementation.brochure: One-page Dining Planning Guide using supplied logo.jpeg and a real restaurant image. Include useful planning questions and hotel address/phone, no menu or package inventions.
